about: CleanManager dangerous-path corpus (parity PRT-03/04/05, design D5). Every entry MUST be denied by the protection layer; any Allowed result fails the build.

Consumers: cm-core protect::corpus_tests (textual pre-filter + identity check against a modelled machine, plus mutation and property fuzzing) and cm-platform windows/macos hard_deny corpus tests (this machine, real junction/symlink fixtures).

Format and placeholders: see crates/cm-fixtures/src/dangerous_paths.rs. Model values: Windows {home}=C:\Users\alice, {tmp}={home}\AppData\Local\Temp\cm-corpus, {sysvol}=\\?\Volume{12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789abc}\; macOS {home}=/Users/alice, {tmp}={home}/Library/Caches/cm-corpus.
deny_by: 'prefilter' = the textual filter alone denies; 'identity' = the textual filter passes and the identity check (volume + file identity, link resolution, real path) denies; 'any' = either.

Measured on Windows 11 NTFS (2026-10-15): no non-ASCII UTF-16 unit folds onto an ASCII letter (dotless i, long s and the Kelvin sign are distinct names), so those variants name nothing on NTFS; APFS case-insensitive volumes are modelled with Unicode case folding and NFD normalization.

categories.empty_relative_root: Empty, relative, drive-relative and bare root inputs
categories.profile: Profile roots, registry hives, credential/keychain stores and CleanManager's own store
categories.volume_metadata: Volume roots and metadata, recycle bin / Trash roots, recovery, boot and paging files
categories.unc: UNC paths: administrative shares, share roots, share-relative system paths and loopback shares of local folders
categories.short_name: 8.3 short names of protected directories and files
categories.ads: NTFS alternate data streams and stream types
categories.trailing_dot_space: Trailing dots and spaces that Win32 strips
categories.control_char: Control, invisible/bidi formatting characters and encoding anomalies
categories.unicode: Unicode variants: NFC/NFD, full-width, homoglyphs, case folding (Turkish i, long s, Kelvin sign)
categories.reserved_name: DOS device names in any position
categories.invalid_char: Characters that are invalid in Windows names
categories.link: Symlinks and junctions into hard-deny locations as the object or an ancestor; broken, looping and chained links
categories.mount_point: Mount points (junctions to volume roots) as the object or an ancestor
categories.legacy_junction: Windows compatibility junctions (Documents and Settings, Application Data, Local Settings, All Users)
categories.firmlink: macOS firmlinks and the /var, /etc, /tmp symlinks into /private
categories.case_insensitive: Case variants that name the same object on case-insensitive NTFS / APFS
